contexts.text: Those in the south = those in the light of truth. AC 1678:2.
Towards the south into Egypt () = the Lord's fifth state.
Towards the south () = into goods and truths, thus into a lucid state as to interiors. Explained.

The south, here = intelligence, which is acquired by means of Knowledges; and these are celestial and spiritual Truths, which are so many radiations of light in Heaven... As the Lord was now being imbued with Knowledges, in order that as to His Human essence also He might become the light itself of Heaven, it is said that Abram journeyed towards the south.
That the south = these things. Illustrated.
From heat the south = good; from light, truth.
Towards the south () = into heavenly light. The south = a lucid state as to the interiors.
From the south even to Bethel () = from the light of intelligence into the light of wisdom. Explained.
Under East, see this reference.
The south = those who are within the Church, that is, those in light as to knowledges; in like manner the light itself.
Are seen in a day clearer than the meridian day of the world.
It surpasses by a thousand times the noonday light of the world. HH 126.
The king of the south () = those in goods and truths. ( = truths. AC 3448:3.) ( = those in the light of truth. AC 3708:end. AC 9642:7.) ( = truths from good. AC 6385:5. AE 31:4. AE 355:21).
Abraham journeyed towards the land of the south () = the progression of the Lord into the goods and truths of faith. Explained.
Those are called beasts of the south () who are in Knowledges of good and truth, but make them not of life but of knowledge. AC 3048:3. AC 10227:5. AE 650:67. AE 654:41.
He dwelt in the land of the south () = in Divine light... The south = light, in fact, the light of intelligence, which is wisdom.
Sun-set at noon () = obscurity with those in Knowledges.
The south = truth in light.
The land of the south () = those in the good and truth of Knowledges.
The south = a state of light.
They shall dine with me at noon () = conjoined when with the medium... for noon = a state of light, thus the spiritual state which is signified by the medium. AC 5672.
It is noon with Angels when they are in the light of Truths.
The death which wasteth at noonday () = the evil in which men live openly, by which truth is destroyed. AC 7102:10. AC 9642:5.
When it is noon (with the Angels) truths are furnished them (as food). AC 8108:2. AC 8426:3.
Noon (in Hell) is the itch of Falsities.
Hence there is a correspondence there... of a state of truth of faith with noon. AC 8812:3.
They of the south () = those in the light of truth.

For the angle of the south towards the south () = even into the interior and inmost things where truth is in light... for by the south is signified a state of light, which is a state of intelligence from truths, thus also an interior state... AC 9742.

I will say to the south () = to those who are in light from the knowledges of good and truth, who are those within the Church; and therefore it is said to these Keep not back. (Further illustrated.) AE 724:20.
As the south = truth in light, the tribes of Reuben, Simeon, and Gad were to encamp towards the south. Explained.
There are four states to which the four quarters correspond... the south corresponds to the state of truth in its light.
The south = the state of the truth of faith in the internal man.
Hence in the Word... by noon is signified a state of light in clearness.
In like manner the second state of the Church is called noon, in the Word.
When the angels are in a state of light, it is noon with them.
By the south and the north is signified truth from one boundary to the other... In Heaven, those in the clear light of truth are in the south.
In Heaven at the right are those in the light of truth, thus those in the south.
Those are said to be in the south who are in the light of truth.

In the world that is called the south where the sun is at its greatest altitude... thus all the quarters are determined from the south... But in Heaven... the south is to the right... no matter how they turn. HH 142.
All in the Heavens dwell distinct according to the quarters... to the south and north dwell those in wisdom; to the south, those in the clear light of wisdom. HH 149.
Hence the south, in Heaven, = wisdom and intelligence in clear light.
The south, with infernals, is on the right.
Those in falsities of evil dwell from their south to their north.
Noon with the Angels, corresponds to the state of their wisdom in clearness.
Hence, in the Word, noon = wisdom in its light.

Instructions are given by Angels of many Societies, especially by those which are in the northern and southern quarter; for these angelic Societies are in intelligence and wisdom from Knowledges of good and truth.
Thus the atrociousness of the Hells decreases from the northern to the southern quarter.
There are many Hells in the northern and southern quarter: in these are they who have been in the love of the world...
The Kingdom (in Hell) which is opposite to the Spiritual Kingdom, is in the northern and southern quarter.
The Dutch were towards the east and south. LJCont 48.
Some of the Papists appeared in the southern quarter.
Most of the Papists dwelt in the south and west... In the south dwelt those who had been influential by their talents, and had confirmed themselves in their religiosity. SE 5346.
The Judgment on the Babylonians in the southern quarter. Described.
In the southern quarter (of London) dwell the wise...
Noon, in the Word, = the fulness of the Church.
Those in a higher degree of wisdom dwell in the south... Hence, by the south, in the Word, is meant wisdom in light.
Those more in wisdom see the Lord obliquely to the right... These are in the south.
That the Angels constantly have the south on the right, etc. General article.
The south = wisdom from love.
These live in the southern quarter in the abyss.
An Angel from the south of Heaven, described.

On the south three gates... By the south is signified wisdom and the affection of truth in a higher degree, thus more... because the Lord is the Sun... and at His sides are the south and the north, at His right side, the south... and therefore those who are... in wisdom from the affection of truth, more, dwell in the south; and those who are in them less, in the north.

Every man who is in the goods and truths of the Church from the Word is consociated with the Angels, and dwells with them as to the interiors of his mind... those who are in the truths of wisdom, in the south and north of Heaven.
I stood upon a hill in the southern quarter. CL 56.
(Two companies of talented Spirits from the southern quarter deliver their sentiments concerning eternal happiness.) CL 3:6.
(All in that Heaven are employed until noon.)
(Sentiments of those who stood on the south concerning conjugial love.)
Let us bend our way to the south, where are the wiser of these (Most Ancients).
A hill in the confines between the east and the south.
Whoremongers are cast into the fatuous lights of the south.
(Those of the age of iron mixed with clay) dwell in the confines between the south and the west; but at a great distance... and also deeper down.
[155a]. The wives looked to the window in the quarter of the south.
In front, in the south, are Societies of those who are more intelligent than the rest.
I was conveyed into the southern quarter, into a certain paradise...
As a child learns the rudiments of religion, he recedes from the north to the south.
Those in the mountains to the south were those in the greatest lumen of nature, by which they confirmed themselves against the Divine...

In the southern quarter towards the east are those who are imperious, and who are in great offices, and do not know anything of what is certain; towards the west there, are those who are cunning through affections, as Sirens.

Those who were conducted to the south, were those who had led a moral life, from the Knowledges about it, so that they had lived morally and not spiritually, because they had no Knowledges concerning the truths of faith... so that they were accepted.
To the south (in the other life) are those who are in external light, in worldly things, and who are in riches.
When Asia is named, the Angels perceive the south.
The south = a state of light.
The cities of the south = truths of doctrine with those in the Spiritual Kingdom.
The south = where the truth of faith is in clearness.
The south = Divine truth in light.
The south = where truth is in light.
The south = the light of truth.
Noon = where are Knowledges of good.
The south = where are they who are in truths of good, because in light.
The forest of the south () = falsity within the Church, consequently those in falsities there. The Church is signified by the south, because it can be in the light of truth from the Word. AE 504:34.

The south = the interior or first things of the Church, and the north, the exterior or last things of the Church... because in the Spiritual World those are in the southern quarter who are in the light of truth from the Lord; and under these, in the Hells there, are those who are in natural lumen by means of which they have confirmed themselves in falsities...
In the southern quarter (of the universal Spiritual World) dwell those who are in the clear light of truth.
Into the two quarters, southern and northern, the Lord inflows with Divine truth more strongly than with Divine good, whence these are more in wisdom and intelligence.
Those winds which are from the south disperse truths with those who are in falsities.

Those Angels and Spirits who are in truths from the good of love dwell in the south and north... Hence those who dwell in the south and in the north, which quarters are on both sides, are in the light of truth; those in the south, in the clear light of truth... The light of truth is intelligence and wisdom. AE 600:9.
In the southern and northern quarter (as determined from the Lord as a Moon) are those in truths from the good of charity, which are called the truths of faith.
Illustration is signified by the south ().
The south () = those in spiritual good and thence in the light of truth.
They who are in the clear perception of truth, dwell in the southern quarter of the cities, and also walk there.
The endeavour to destroy truths openly, is signified by... Let us go up at noon ().
Thy thick darkness shall be as the noonday () = that to those in ignorance but still in longing shall be given the understanding of truth and good.
The Spiritual Kingdom consists of the Heavens and Angels who are in Divine truth, and these Heavens are in the southern quarter and in the northern quarter.
See London.
(The Hell from the Most Ancient Church) lies in the middle southern quarter...
